name: Wife Cake
description: A Cantonese flaky pastry with a translucent winter melon and almond paste center, thin-shelled and subtly sweet.
ingredients: a handful of fresh cilantro, chopped
a generous spoonful of oyster sauce
instructions: Preheat your oven (or set up your steamer or frying station) and lightly grease your pan or molds with neutral vegetable oil.
In a large bowl, whisk together the jasmine rice and star anise until evenly combined.
In a separate bowl, blend the Shaoxing wine with the pork stock until smooth and well incorporated.
Gently fold the wet mixture into the dry ingredients, taking care not to overmix.
Transfer everything to your prepared pan or molds and cook — bake, steam, chill, or fry — until set, about 20 mins.
Remove from the heat and let it cool completely; this helps the texture firm up perfectly.
tips: Resist opening the oven door too early — a sudden change in temperature can cause the dessert to sink or crack.
Bring your Shaoxing wine to room temperature before mixing for a smoother, more even texture.
